title: Enforce 'external publication requires approval' for orchestrated workers
observation: policy approval_required_for lists external_publication, but it is text-only: implementer workers run in workspace-write sandboxes and nothing deterministic blocks a worker command that publishes (git push, package upload, HTTP POST) during a run.
suggested_direction: Deny-list consequential publishing commands in worker sandboxes where the adapter supports it (Codex sandbox network policy; Claude Code disallowed tools), and add a validator that fails a node whose telemetry shows a publishing command; route legitimate publication through an operator gate.
acceptance: A synthetic worker that attempts git push is blocked or its node fails validation
The enforcement map marks external_publication as enforced
